calculation_handling.description: Scope statement: the regulations in Section 150.25 apply to multi-tenant houses.
Despite 900.1.10(3) and 900.1.10(4)(A), a multi-tenant house is permitted if it complies with the zone regulations and Section 150.25.
When part of a semi-detached house or townhouse is converted to a multi-tenant house, the remaining portions on abutting lots are deemed to be in the original building type.
calculation_handling.gaps: Conversion history of existing buildings is not held.

units.disclosure: The deeming of unconverted portions of a semi-detached house or townhouse as the original building type is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: A converted building must comply with the zone regulations and the regulations in Section 150.25.

150.25.1(1).explanation: The multi-tenant house rules in Section 150.25 apply to multi-tenant houses.

150.25.1(2).explanation: Despite the Chapter 900 exception rules in 900.1.10(3) and 900.1.10(4)(A), a multi-tenant house is permitted if it meets the regulations for its zone and Section 150.25.

150.25.1(3).explanation: A residential building, or part of one, may be converted to a multi-tenant house and stay a lawfully existing building. When part of a semi-detached house or townhouse is converted, the remaining parts on abutting lots are treated as the original building type. A converted building must meet the zone regulations and Section 150.25.
